rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Gatekeeper
card.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before joining our cheese panel, identify this rind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just came to eat cheese.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then identify it for the tasting queue. Judging requires the county certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have that certificate. I teach the county course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Before you examine our cheese, let me examine your syllabus.

card.title: The Gatekeeper
card.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may judge the garden competition once I check your pruning certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a street competition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then a street-level certificate should suffice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who certified you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question requires an advanced certificate.

card.title: Rightful Place
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why is someone sitting in my chair at the founders' dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's a sponsor. Have you brought your founder's invitation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You need an envelope to establish that I founded this place?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know you did. I'll bring another chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For him, thank you. Put mine back at the head.

card.title: Rightful Place
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my nameplate on the committee chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's an election first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An election confirms legitimacy. It doesn't invent my chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll need to nominate yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How insulting. The nameplate already has.

card.title: The Crown Must Pass
card.instruction: Treat another person as your likely successor. Prepare them to lead, then reclaim authority whenever their independence makes your influence feel temporary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the café key. Your first day in charge. I'll watch quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm opening an hour later. You won't have to come in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Check timetable changes with me first. Regulars need continuity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain it to them myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good practice. I'll stand beside you and handle any questions about the hours.

card.title: The Crown Must Pass
card.instruction: Treat another person as your likely successor. Prepare them to lead, then reclaim authority whenever their independence makes your influence feel temporary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my chair, deputy. Lead the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: First, let's remove the old approval process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent confidence. I'll need to approve that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the process I'm removing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your first lesson is tact around the chair's previous occupant.

card.title: The Quiet Veto
card.instruction: Remain pleasant and cooperative while behaving as though nothing can proceed without your private consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love your exhibition to happen. I haven't signed the room form yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The installer needs it by four. Is there anything I can change?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing. It's lovely. I just need to feel ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll book the other gallery. They don't need your signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll gladly introduce you. Let me approve the email before you send it.

card.title: The Quiet Veto
card.instruction: Remain pleasant and cooperative while behaving as though nothing can proceed without your private consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The youth club trip sounds wonderful. I've helped finish the coach booking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thanks. We just need your funding code.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll send it when I'm comfortable releasing it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit with you while you check the figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. The figures are fine. You can help me write a reassuring update while everyone waits.

card.title: We Started Equal
card.instruction: Use shared beginnings to erase present rank, titles, and attempts to place distance between you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We started on the same biscuit-packing line. Pass the biscuits, Director.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please use my title at work. The new staff are here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. This is the director. We shared my lunch when he forgot his.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you tell them something more recent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's sharing today. Pass that tin, mate; I'll do the introductions.

card.title: We Started Equal
card.instruction: Use shared beginnings to erase present rank, titles, and attempts to place distance between you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've pulled my chair beside yours for the induction. Like our first day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm introducing myself as their manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce us together. We spent our first morning looking for the toilets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You show them around after my welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come with me. You found the toilets; I found the kitchen. We still make one useful employee.

card.title: My Support, My Say
card.instruction: Treat every past favor as a continuing investment in your right to influence present decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I funded your bakery mixer. I should help choose the new menu.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a birthday gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To a particular vision of cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm making bread now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my investment needs a meeting with bread.

card.title: My Support, My Say
card.instruction: Treat every past favor as a continuing investment in your right to influence present decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before changing the club name, remember who paid the deposit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've paid you back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The money, yes. I still backed the club we're naming.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The printer needs a name today. Pick between these two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me see the rejected names too. My support deserves more than the final round.

card.title: The Trusted Deputy
card.instruction: Act as the reliable second-in-command, managing access and details while quietly shaping every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've prepared the director's options. Mine is first, in larger print.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steering the decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, assisting its visibility.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put them in alphabetical order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I've named mine 'A Sensible Beginning.'

card.title: The Trusted Deputy
card.instruction: Act as the reliable second-in-command, managing access and details while quietly shaping every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The captain's finishing the briefing. As first mate, I'm collecting route updates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The harbor's closed. She needs the inland route now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll mark the closure clearly and attach my coastal alternative.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take it in myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Let me announce you as bringing the closure report and our coastal recommendation.

card.title: The Succession Race
card.instruction: Treat every success, mistake, and compliment as evidence in an ongoing contest over who should lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I fixed the office kettle. Put that in my column for next manager.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no vacancy. Sam bought the replacement fuse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give Sam procurement. Give me delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You two could fix the toaster together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll coordinate Sam. We can finally compare technical ability with leadership.

card.title: The Succession Race
card.instruction: Treat every success, mistake, and compliment as evidence in an ongoing contest over who should lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sam forgot the meeting again. I've added it to my leadership comparison.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There isn't a leadership contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my perfect attendance is comfortably ahead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm cancelling today's meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll record that I arrived for it anyway.

card.title: Indispensable Rival
card.instruction: Use another person’s judgment constantly while minimizing how much influence that dependence gives them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Check my wedding speech again. Just punctuation this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cut the divorce joke. The bride's parents separated last month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, that's why I flagged it. What should replace it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use my story about them getting lost on their first date. Credit me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank you for proofreading. How does your story end?

card.title: Indispensable Rival
card.instruction: Use another person’s judgment constantly while minimizing how much influence that dependence gives them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which road gets us to the wedding? I'm checking my choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: East. The west bridge is closed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As I thought. Which east turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Give me the map and let me navigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can hold it. I'll make the decisions. Is this the turn?

card.title: Once Undermined
card.instruction: Treat every disagreement as a possible repeat of the moment your authority was previously weakened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time someone moved lunch, they held the meeting without me. Why move it again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sandwich delivery's late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what they said while electing my replacement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then we'll eat in here. You can keep chairing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put the sandwiches beside me. Last time everyone followed whoever had the platter.

card.title: Once Undermined
card.instruction: Treat every disagreement as a possible repeat of the moment your authority was previously weakened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You crossed out my tea order, Pat. Last year it was my shed proposal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only need twenty cups. You ordered forty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how the committee started calling my judgment unreliable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll write that the attendance changed. This isn't a vote on you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Put that last sentence in the minutes too.

transfer.action: I put a qualifications checklist in front of {prop}.
transfer.closing: Then meeting the entry standard should be exceptionally easy.

transfer.action: I set my nameplate beside {prop} without asking for a place.
transfer.opening: The seat doesn't need another audition. {request}
transfer.response: I already belong on this side of the desk. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then the application system successfully located everyone who wasn't already here.

transfer.action: I pass {prop} toward you but keep one finger on it.
transfer.opening: Your first decision. I'll approve it afterward. {request}
transfer.response: You can lead from the chair beside mine. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Doesn't succeeding you mean replacing you?
transfer.closing: It could mean continuing with particularly close access to your predecessor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're ready to run the cafe. Before changing the hours, announce that I approve the final timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just gave me the keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now I need you to give the staff a clear account of who decides.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'm not really succeeding you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're succeeding beautifully at recognising when experience should take over again.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A prepares a successor but seeks a public return of authority as soon as that successor acts independently; the handoff itself drives the reversal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can chair today's meeting. Start by naming me your final appeals authority.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I hand power back immediately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because leadership includes knowing whom to consult.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I planned to make my own decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent independence. Now introduce the person authorised to review it.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A prepares a successor but seeks a public return of authority as soon as that successor acts independently; the handoff itself drives the reversal.

transfer.action: I smile with my pen above the last approval beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'd love this to go ahead. {request}
transfer.response: I'm not obstructing it; I simply haven't agreed. {counter}
transfer.closing: No. I'm leaving everyone an opportunity to bring me a better version.

transfer.action: I put our matching first-day badges beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Same first day. Same two nervous people. {request}
transfer.response: Leave the new title outside this minute. {counter}
transfer.closing: Those two cheap badges are still the same price.

transfer.action: I lay my original contribution receipt beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: My support helped make this possible. {request}
transfer.response: I still have a stake in what it becomes. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You said it was a gift.
transfer.closing: To the project I recognized. I'd like to recognize it again.

transfer.action: I arrange the papers around {prop} in the order the chair will see them.
transfer.response: This page should naturally appear first. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You're deciding what the leader sees.
transfer.closing: Only making sure the right decision has a comfortable entrance.

transfer.action: I place my record of successes beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: For whenever the leadership question arises, {request}
transfer.response: I'm not campaigning, just organizing evidence. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then this is admirably early preparation for an obvious future task.

transfer.action: I pass you the difficult part of {prop} without looking up.
transfer.opening: I'd welcome a merely supplementary opinion. {request}
transfer.response: I was very close to that answer myself. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Why not admit you need advice?
transfer.closing: Because I'd rather discuss the advice than its unfortunate necessity.

transfer.action: I open the file of an old overturned decision beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I've watched a friendly question become a challenge. {request}
transfer.response: That was how it began last time. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I'm questioning the idea, not you.
transfer.closing: Then use my whole title while you explain the difference.
